name: SPACInsider
description:
SPACInsider provides read-only access to comprehensive SPAC market data through a hosted MCP server. Ask questions about the SPAC universe, point-in-time historical snapshots, IPO counts, underwriter league tables, participant relationships, corporate actions, and lockup/earnout terms.

The connector uses OAuth via spacinsider.com. Data is retrieved through structured MCP tools.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SPACInsider to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SPACInsider to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.spacinsider.com/v2/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SPACInsider MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SPACInsider lists 29 MCP tools, including corporate_action_list, data_discover, get_usage_guide, leagues_13f, leagues_list, leagues_participants_despac, leagues_participants_ipo, leagues_pipe_investor, leagues_private_placement, leagues_serial_sponsor, lockup_earnout_list, and mcp_health.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SPACInsider?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to SPACInsider in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
SPACInsider requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SPACInsider is developed by SPACInsider. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
